## Definition of Done Checklist
- [ ] Code follows project branch naming rules (`feature/<task-id>-<short-name>`, `develop`, `main`)

- [ ] Task report in `docs/task-reports/task-XX.md` updated with real outcomes
- [ ] Role-based access constraints respected (Customer, Analyst, Administrator)
- [ ] Valid plan status transitions adhered to (`DRAFT → IN_REVIEW → PUBLISHED → ARCHIVED`)
